sample_rule: Lowest SHA256 of trajectory-v1:seed:physical_case_id over all eligible protocol origins before examining future support or outcomes. Same selected IDs across all fits and models. Retain censoring denominators.
origin_inputs: Reuse source-bound final-horizon saved state_k256 and iid_origin arrays, with exact case ID and output hash checks. No new neural inference.
scoring: Joint sequence NLL and NLL per observed decision; forward marginalization over latent paths, no future state assignments. Zero support reported as infinite NLL with support-failure counts, never clipped.
inference: Equal original users within each fully observed sampled horizon; paired user-cluster percentile intervals with 2000 shared resamples when both model losses finite. Descriptive exploratory comparisons, no new confirmatory success criterion.
not_joint_models: Direct marginal horizon heads do not define a coherent sequence distribution and are not multiplied into a trajectory forecast. Frozen-origin iid comparators explicitly remain weak joint baselines.
prerequisites: Complete source-bound sequence reconstruction and aggregate target replay
Bind all ten final-horizon output identities and all model identities
Lock source and config identities before first trajectory score
scope: Exploratory recorded click trajectories under the logging policy, conditional on observed horizons. No intentional abandonment, arbitrary-interface, causal transfer or psychological state claim.
